text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ci\u003EHello everyone I'm a medical intern.This blog is to share my experiences and cases I came across during this period\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003EThis is an online E log book to post and discuss our patient's de-identified health data posted after taking informed consent where we discuss patient-centered clinical problems through series of discussions among the community of experts without letting the patient move to distant places to different doctors with an aim to solve their clinical problems with the collective best evidence input from them. This online platform also reflects my patient-centered learning portfolio.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECase presentation:\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA\u0026nbsp; text-align: center;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ci\u003EHello everyone I'm a medical intern.This blog is to share my experiences and cases I came across during this period\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Ci\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/i\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv class=\"separator\"\u003EThis is an online E log book to post and discuss our patient's de-identified health data posted after taking informed consent where we discuss patient-centered clinical problems through series of discussions among the community of experts without letting the patient move to distant places to different doctors with an aim to solve their clinical problems with the collective best evidence input from them. This online platform also reflects my patient-centered learning portfolio.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cfont style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EHer first pregnancy was in 2015 ,during which she suffered abdominal pain in third month, and\u0026nbsp; UTI later on\u0026nbsp; for which she used medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EShe gave birth to preterm child in 8th month of pregnancy,who died on 5th day after delivery with ??congenital heart disease.she also gave history of usage of\u0026nbsp; ??ring pesary.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EDuring her second pregnancy also\u0026nbsp; she gave history of UTI and usage of\u0026nbsp; ?? ring pesary. Even second child died on 3rd day of delivery.( cause _ not clear)\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EBoth the deliveries are with caessarian section\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EDuring third pregnancy ( current one) also she gave history of UTI and no usage of ring pesary.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EBut delivered a healthy baby currently 21 day old .\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003ETheir marriage is non consaguinous.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003ENow mother came to hospital with thrombocytopenia and chest pain\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;On examination\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;Pr _ 140 bpm regular\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u0026nbsp; \u0026nbsp;BP _ 110\/70\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003ENo other significant findings on examination\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EInitially cause of chest pain was interpreted as costochondritis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003Eas\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E1. ecg was showing only tachycardia\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E2. 2d echo _ normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E3. Chest x ray _normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003ECause of thrombocytopenia was interpreted as drug induced as she is using NSAIDS ( for post caessarian section\u0026nbsp; pain)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003Eand no other routine\u0026nbsp; investigations were sent as\u0026nbsp; patient is asymptomatic\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight: bold;\"\u003EBut to rule out HELLP\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv style=\"font-weight:
